checks.criterion: AC5: Hypothesis property test for nonnegative powers, power conservation and echo share
checks.evidence: test_polarimetry_stokes.py:769–792 generates positive S1 and bounded S4 and asserts all required identities. The property test was not executed because checks were prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC6: Docstring explains factor 2 and product-label power definitions
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:744–747 explicitly states that factor 2 cancels in CPR but not absolute powers and that the selected product label defines its Stokes powers.

checks.criterion: Previous findings codex-r1-1 and codex2-r1-1: verify squared-tolerance fix

Additional boundary and scale tests appear at lines 461–507. Execution remains NOT_RUN.
